---
title: "Contribute"
---

## Propose a principle (no code needed)

If you are an astrologer and want a classical principle tested, open a
[research request](https://github.com/astro-fusion/astro_research-white-paper/issues/new/choose)
with:

- the principle in plain words (planets, configuration, window of time);
- the kind of event it is said to relate to;
- the classical source: text, chapter and verse;
- one or two dates when you expect it to hold, and one when you expect it not to.

A maintainer turns it into a rule file and runs it against the reference
charts before it enters a study.

## Add code

Developers can add predicates, studies or statistical tests. The developer
guide is [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/astro-fusion/astro_research-white-paper/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md);
the repository layout is described in
[docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/astro-fusion/astro_research-white-paper/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

## Report an error

If a chart, a calculation or a figure looks wrong, please open an issue. Errors
that affect published results are recorded on the [Corrections](corrections.qmd)
page.
